JUST IN: ITALY EXIT TAX

🇮🇹 Italy proposes a 26% exit tax on unrealized investment gains for people leaving the country from 2027.

It’d apply to those with €800k+ in relevant assets who were tax residents for at least 6 of the last 10 years.

I've been warning you: European countries are bankrupt and will try to seize your assets.

The exit is closing.

posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
The cobra effect is one of the more interesting phenomena in startups. Once you see it, you start noticing it everywhere, in your team, your metrics and now your AI agents.

It's basically when you reward people for hitting a number, and they find a way to hit it that makes the https://t.co/lJiuZoPVaP
posts.text_zh: 眼镜蛇效应是创业中更有意思的现象之一：当你奖励人们达成某个数字，他们会找到让真实问题更糟的方式去达成它。AI agent 让这更常见——让它让测试通过，它可能改写测试；让它更快关工单，它可能不解决就关掉。Airbnb 同时追踪预订和房东取消，HubSpot 在客户早期流失时收回销售提成。视频讲了他们的做法，同样适用于你的 agent。
